extent_reference.interpretation: protected site extent proxy; not land, water, road or historical evidence

road_source.limitations: Retained original segments only with both nodes in selection bbox; no access, routing, completeness or historical claims.
road_source.prior_acquisition_coverage_limitation: Corrected map extends east and north beyond acquisition bbox; raw tiles unavailable; the retained snapshot selection bbox is smaller.

coastline.limitations: The retrieved chain is node-connected with outside endpoints and four map-boundary crossings; it does not prove physical shoreline completeness, tidal interpretation or valid land/sea polygons.

output.distribution: private local derived output; excluded from repository pending rights review

footprint_estimate.method: 512 intervals per WGS84 bbox side, transformed to EPSG:25830 then polygon/cell intersection
footprint_estimate.interpretation: Approximate selection footprint, not guaranteed road coverage.

acquisition_footprint_estimate.method: 512 intervals per WGS84 bbox side, transformed to EPSG:25830 then polygon/cell intersection
acquisition_footprint_estimate.interpretation: Historical request footprint only; raw tile cache unavailable; not evidence of complete road coverage.

new_road_samples.note: Earlier acquisition does not cover north/east of corrected grid; new samples do not establish full coverage.

overpass_attempt.mirrors: kumi and private.coffee timed out after 45 seconds

bounded_lattice_2026_10_30.cap_overrun: First run counted response bodies only. Headers exceeded the requested total 100 MB cap; TLS/request/protocol overhead unmeasured. Code now budgets header bytes and reserves 1 MB for protocol overhead.
bounded_lattice_2026_10_30.identity_conflicts: zero node version/coordinates or highway/coastline way version, node sequence and selected class tags; other tags not compared
bounded_lattice_2026_10_30.limitation: Request footprint does not guarantee source completeness, access, legal routability or land/water classification; all raw and derived data are private under /tmp.

resumed_lattice_2026_10_30.limitation: Partial non-atomic source and existing graph does not encode turn restrictions; no full-footprint directed network produced.

completed_lattice_2026_10_30.interpretation: Full request footprint, not source completeness, access or a verified land/sea polygon.

directed_road_candidate.status: private source candidate; not operational access
directed_road_candidate.restriction_policy: Retain raw restriction tags and members, exclude referenced ways and arcs incident to via nodes; no turn-relation execution.
directed_road_candidate.boundary_policy: Both original endpoints must be inside bounds for a routable arc; crossings are retained only as evidence.
directed_road_candidate.supersedes: v1 allowed outside junctions and was removed

blockers: OSM map bbox API can omit crossing ways without nodes inside the request bbox
non-atomic snapshot and physical source completeness unverified
coastline land-side does not prove absence of inland water
